primaryChecks.text: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

primaryChecks.nextContext: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.
